summary: Tested logistics 'UniRoute' app end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (list, status filters, get-by-id with leg counts/modes, 404, lookup by reference, case-insensitive). Frontend: landing page loads with sidebar (nav-transit/completed/delayed), hero + search input, example chips, stats, 4 shipment cards, filter buttons (filter-active/completed/delayed) update URL and list correctly, sidebar nav links update URL, example-chip click reveals unified-timeline with 4 timeline nodes for SHP-2025-3155 (road/ocean/air/road), invalid ID shows error toast 'Shipment ... not found', card click navigates to /shipment/:id detail page rendering MultimodalTimeline (3 nodes for SHP-2025-1042). Status badges (Active/Completed/Delayed) render correctly. No console pageerrors.
action_items: OPTIONAL: ShipmentCard uses identical data-testid='shipment-card' for every card. For better test addressability, consider per-id testid like 'shipment-card-SHP-2025-3155'. Functionality is unaffected; tests can use nth-of-type or query_selector_all.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is small (~310 lines), well-typed with Pydantic. Lookup is case-insensitive on both id and reference.
MongoDB client created but unused for shipments (mock data only) — acceptable for MVP, but the unused motor client adds an idle connection. Could be lazily initialized.
/api/shipments status filter accepts arbitrary strings and silently returns empty list for unknown statuses (no 400). Acceptable but consider validating with Literal/Enum.
All ShipmentCards share data-testid='shipment-card' — duplicate testids reduce test specificity. Recommend appending the shipment id.
seed_data_creation: None (mock data hardcoded in backend SHIPMENTS list)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_shipments.py covers all endpoints (10 tests, all passing). Mock-data app, no DB writes. Sample IDs: SHP-2025-1042 (road/ocean/road, active), SHP-2025-2081 (road/air/road, completed), SHP-2025-3155 (road/ocean/air/road, active), SHP-2025-4209 (ocean/road, delayed). Reference lookup works (e.g., PO-88421-A). Frontend cards use data-testid='shipment-card' (non-unique).
